content.value: a. What do you understand by "Housing Rights"? How are housing rights (10) guaranteed by international organization and why do we need them?
b. What are the major components of a functional housing market? Explain all of (12) those components with example.
C. “Adequate housing is determined in part by social economic, cultural, climatic, (13) ecological and other factors"- explain with examples.
